lines.rom: sri guru carana saroja chavi nija mana mandira dhari sumari gajanana sarada gahi asisa tripurari
buddhihina jana janiye avagunom ka bhandara baranaum parasurama suyasa nija mati ke anusara
jaya prabhu parasurama sukha sagara jaya munisa guna jnana divakara
bhrgukula mukuta bikata ranadhira ksatriya teja mukha samta sarira
jamadagni suta renuka jaya teja pratapa sakala jaga chaya
masa baisakha sita paccha udara trtiya punarvasu manuhara
prahara prathama nisa sita na ghama tithi pradosa byapi sukhadhama
taba rsi kutira rudana sisu kinha renuka kokhi janama hari linha
nija ghara ucca graha chah tharhe mithuna rasi rahu sukha garhe
teja jnana mila nara tanu dhara jamadagni ghara brahma avatara
